description: Eastern Province - Eastern Province Tourism Bureau - 2015
reasoning: This gazette content announces the enactment of the Eastern Province Tourism Bureau Statute No. 01 of 2016, which establishes a new legal framework and regulatory body for tourism development within the Eastern Province. It creates a corporate entity, defines its composition, powers, and procedures, and explicitly states its relationship with existing national legislation (Tourist Development Act, No. 14 of 1968). This falls squarely under the definition of "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves the creation of new laws, regulations, and statutory instruments.
